Vendored, unmodified, into `.claude/skills/`:

| Command | Internal name | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| `/taste-skill` | `design-taste-frontend` | Main anti-generic design rules for landing pages and marketing sites |
| `/redesign-skill` | `redesign-existing-projects` | Auditing and upgrading an existing site's look |
| `/soft-skill` | `high-end-visual-design` | "Expensive agency" style preset |
| `/minimalist-skill` | `minimalist-ui` | Clean editorial / warm monochrome style preset |

To update: re-copy the four `SKILL.md` files from a newer commit and change the commit above.
How these apply to WordPress is in `docs/design-taste.md`.
